caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a teapot viewed from the side. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with smooth, reflective surfaces rendered in shades of gray to suggest metallic material, possibly silver. The central body sits on a short, round pedestal base. The spout emerges from the left side of the teapot and features ornate detailing at its base and a bird-like tip. The handle on the right is large, ornate, and curves upward, rendered in a darker shade to indicate a different material, possibly wood or ebony. The lid of the teapot is domed with a finial on top, and delicate foliage patterns are etched around the upper shoulder near the base of the lid. The composition is centered, and the background is plain and unadorned, focusing attention entirely on the teapot. The entire drawing is executed in graphite or pencil, resulting in a monochromatic color scheme dominated by grayscale tones.
title: Silver Teapot
